data.title: CI flake: api test 'the size of a run > starting again while a run is in flight answers that same run' failed once in CI on 5c9be4a (VERSION-only commit): took 5.2s, second start answered 409 instead of 200; passes locally 12/12 and passed in CI at 0905f30. Look at seedSent (5000 rows) timing and the 409 paths in categorize_run_start (no_categories / too_many_categories) under CI load.
